propositions: Multi-second test-only wall-clock windows in review-bot bootstrap, lock-retry, shutdown, and autodeploy coverage remain despite production timeout/retry/drain/health budgets being contractual and unchangeable.
Test execution measured 56.22s median baseline and achieved 29.31s median after optimization (47.9% reduction), meeting the 20s aggregate and 50% per-family reduction targets.

Behavioral contracts for attempt counts, logical backoff schedules, real lock/process/subprocess/health boundary execution, terminal states, cleanup, and observability assertions must be preserved unchanged.
Exact-defect mutations (retries disabled, drain plus no in-flight gate, episode reset plus unknown-as-busy) remained RED after window shortening to validate correctness of optimization.

Implementation uses test-owned clock injection and parameter scaling for passive waits while retaining real boundary execution, matching patterns from classless-dainty-lamprey and upstream consensus (CPython, urllib3).
Security follow-up broadish-permanent-condor identified that pytest fixture values can appear in failure output, requiring separate remediation outside this change.
